title: Motif Pattern #7304
author: Spool Cotton Co., Spool Cotton #152 Table Treasures (via freevintagecrochet.com)
notes: Public domain vintage pattern. start: original "Starting at center, ch 6, join with sl st." replaced by magic ring. Only the First Motif kept; joining of motifs omitted. Shrinking sc wedges (12 -> 10 -> 8 -> 6 -> 4 sc) with 4-dc blocks in ch-5 loops, then mesh of ch loops with 4dc-ch3-4dc corners. Round 9 'sc between next two 4-dc groups' written as '4sk sc'.
